about: Which preview Retimed copy an item (a Segment, or a video Overlay) plays from (docs/adr/0009). An item plays its file's range, `start` to `end`, at `speed` (1 by default), backwards with `reverse` (false), its pitch following the Speed with `pitch` (false). Its `copy` is the range a copy plays, how (`reverse`, `speed`, `pitch`), or null for an item played from its own file. A browser plays a video at 0.25–4×. Read by backend/tests/test_preview_copies.py and frontend/src/pages/job/editor/retimedCopy.test.ts, so that the backend's rule and the frontend's can't drift.

items.name: at 4x, the fastest a browser plays
at 0.25x, the slowest a browser plays
reversed at 2x, played at its Speed from the reversed copy
